summary: Create new world screen appears even when world is created; clicking on button causes freeze or crash
description: The bug I just created a new world to test out the new features, but the game froze for a second after I enabled the 1.20 data pack. When I clicked on continue, nothing happened until the game unfreeze. But the create world button is in the same place as the continue button. So when the world loaded up, I was met with the create new world screen again. When I created a world again, it got stuck on preparing world for creation Steps to reproduce - Create World Tab - Experiments - Double click on Done - Now, you will get two buttons, if you click Create New World game will softlock
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Navigate to "Singleplayer" and select "Create New World".
3. Go to the "Experiments" tab.
4. Double-click on "Done" in the Experiments tab.
5. Observe that two buttons appear: one for "Continue" and one for "Create New World".
6. Click on the "Create New World" button.
7. Wait until the game softlocks or freezes.
8. Note any freeze or crash behavior observed during the softlock.
Observed Behavior: When attempting to create a new world and test out new features, the game froze for a second after enabling the 1.20 data pack. Upon clicking continue, nothing happened until the game unfroze. The issue is that the "create world" button remains in place even though it should be replaced by the "continue" button once the world has been created. As a result, when the world finally loads up, players are met with the create new world screen again instead of being taken into the newly created world. Attempting to create another world results in the game getting stuck on preparing the world for creation. This leads to a softlock if the "create new world" button is clicked again. The problem persists even after multiple attempts, causing frustration and preventing players from entering their worlds as intended.
Expected Behavior: When following the reproduction steps, creating a new world and enabling the 1.20 data pack should result in the game smoothly transitioning to the newly created world without any freezes or crashes. The "Create New World" screen should not reappear after the world has been successfully loaded, and clicking on buttons should function correctly without causing softlocks or freezes.
